notes: Safer saving: every change is also kept in a second backup database, so plans survive even if the normal browser storage fails.
Saved ✓ sign next to the plan name, and a red warning if a save ever fails.
Earlier versions: Menu › Earlier versions goes back to a copy from a few minutes ago.
PC: Ctrl+S saves to a real .wallcad file, then saves there again automatically every 2 minutes.
Save to Google Drive: on Android through the share menu; on PC to your Google Drive folder.
A friendly reminder to keep a backup of big plans, at most once a day.
